summary.text: Angel Ramirez is a Democratic state representative from Iowa House District 78 who took office in May 2025 after winning a special election and is seeking a full term on November 3, 2026.
Ballotpedia lists her profession as nonprofit executive.

paragraphs.text: Angel Ramirez earned a bachelor's degree from Coe College.
Her career experience includes working as a nonprofit executive director and co-founder, and she has been affiliated with Kids First Law Center.
Ramirez defeated Bernie Hayes in the April 29, 2025 special general election for Iowa House District 78, succeeding Sami Scheetz, and she assumed office on May 13, 2025.
She advanced from the June 2, 2026 Democratic primary and is listed as the candidate in the general election.
